title: Lycoris Recoil: Friends are thieves of time. Anime Short Films Get Manga Adaptation
content:
The six-episode shorts debuted on Aniplex 's official YouTube channel in April 2025. The shorts also streamed on Aniplex USA 's YouTube channel, and on Crunchyroll .

The shorts center on the daily lives of the characters at Café LycoReco.

Bizen launched the Lycoris Recoil manga in Monthly Comic Flapper in September 2022. Kadokawa shipped the ninth compiled book volume on August 21. Yen Press shipped the fifth volume of the manga on June 23.

Asaura 's Lycoris Recoil: Ordinary Days spinoff novel reached over 250,000 copies in circulation in 2022.

Lycoris Recoil premiered in July 2022. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired in Japan, and it also streamed an English dub . The anime also aired on Adult Swim 's Toonami block in January 2024.

The television anime was Shingo Adachi 's directorial debut. Before this anime, Adachi was the character designer and chief animation director for Sword Art Online and Wagnaria!! (Working!!). Imigimuru ( This Art Club Has a Problem! ) designed the television anime, and A-1 Pictures produced the project. Ben-To author Asaura drafted the story. Kimika Onai ( Nogizaka46 , Sakurazaka46 outfits) designed the characters' uniforms.

title: The Dangers in My Heart Season 3 Anime's Teaser Trailer Reveals April 2027 Premiere
content:
The official website for the anime of Norio Sakurai 's The Dangers in My Heart ( Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu ) manga revealed on Friday a teaser promotional video, visual, and April 2027 premiere for the third season .

A compilation film titled The Dangers in My Heart: The Movie opened in Japan on February 13. HIDIVE screened the film in the U.S. on February 16 in Japanese with English subtitles and on February 18 with an English dub . The film has sold more than 170,000 tickets worldwide, including in screenings in the United States, Latin America, France, Germany, Italy, and parts of Asia.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the main manga, and it describes the story:

Ichikawa Kyotaro, a boy barely clinging to the bottom rung of his school's social ladder, secretly believes he's the tortured lead in some psychological thriller. He spends his days dreaming up ways to disrupt his classmates' peaceful lives and pining after Anna Yamada, the class idol. But Kyotaro's not nearly the troubled teen he pretends to be...and it turns out Anna's a bit odd herself!

Sakurai launched the manga in Akita Shoten 's Weekly Shōnen Champion magazine in March 2018. The manga moved to Akita Shoten 's Champion Cross manga website in April 2018. When Champion Cross merged with Akita Shoten 's other manga website Champion Tap! to form the new website Manga Cross in July 2018, the manga moved to that new site. The manga ended on September 15. Akita Shoten published the manga's 14th and final compiled book volume shipped on Friday. Seven Seas Entertainment published the manga's 13th volume on August 25.

The manga's light novel adaptation written by Kota Nozomi ( When Supernatural Battles Became Commonplace ) and illustrated by Sakurai and sune shipped in Japan in September 2024.

The manga's Twi-Yaba spinoff manga also has an anime that premiered in December 2023.

Haika Nanasaka launched a manga spinoff titled Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu Love Comedy ga Hajimaranai ( The Dangers in My Heart : A Romantic Comedy Will Not Start) on the Champion Cross manga website in July 2025.
author: ANN

title: The Dangers in My Heart (BokuYaba) Season 3 New Visual and Trailer Revealed, April 2027 Release
content:
The Dangers in My Heart (BokuYaba) Season 3 revealed a key visual and trailer, along with an April 2027 release date. Studio Shin-Ei is again in charge of the animation production. You can watch the new trailer below.

Also check out the key visual featuring Anna Yamada and Kyotaro Ichikawa:

Norio Sakurai’s The Dangers in My Heart ( BokuYaba ) manga officially ended on September 15, 2026, with its final chapter released on Akita Shoten’s Champion Cross website.

The series began serialization in 2018 in Weekly Shonen Champion before later moving to Champion Cross. It follows Kyotaro Ichikawa, a socially withdrawn middle school student, and Anna Yamada, the popular girl in his class, as they slowly develop a romance despite the completely different personalities.

The manga has over 7 million copies in circulation. The final volume, Volume 14 , releases today on November 6 in Japan. A special edition will also include Kyotaro Ichikawa’s 12th Junior High School Graduation Album Art Book , featuring approximately 200 pages of illustrations.

The first season of the TV anime adaptation ran for 12 episodes in Spring 2023. The second season of the anime ran for a total of 13 episodes in Winter 2024, absolutely dominating our weekly rankings all the way with the first sweep in history. The second season also won the title of 2024 Anime of the Year , along with many other awards.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the title in English, while HIDIVE is streaming the anime. The story follows Kyotaro Ichikawa, a boy who fantasizes about acting on his twisted thoughts, but an encounter with the adorable Anna Yamada completely changes his life.

The franchise also released a novel adaptation on September 25, 2025, with the book featuring 4 short stories, along with showing Kyotaro and Anna 10 years in the future.
author: Anime Corner

title: OceanVeil Streams English Dub of Even the Student Council Has It's Holes! Anime
content:
OceanVeil started streaming the English dub for the television anime of Muchimaro 's Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! ( Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru! ) four-panel manga on October 31. OceanVeil is simultaneously streaming the English dub of the anime's "on air" version and its "unrestricted" version.

The English dub cast members are:

• Alan Lee as Ume Mizunoe

• Courtney Lin as Hisako Kotobuki

• Xanthe Huynh as Komaro Mochinuki

• Alex Cazares as Tan Otori

• Anne Yatco as Arisu Terui

• Stephanie Wong as Satomi Hiratsuka

The anime debuted on October 3 and airs on Tokyo MX , BS11 , Gunma TV , and Tochigi TV . d Anime Store and AnimeFesta stream the anime both in its "on air" version and its "unrestricted" version in Japan. OceanVeil also streams simultaneously the anime with English subtitles in both versions.

Naoyuki Tatsuwa ( Ōmuro-ke , Gourmet Girl Graffiti , Nisekoi - False Love , Promise of Wizard ) is directing the anime at Passione , Ryo Imamura ( ONIMAI: I'm Now Your Sister! ) is designing the characters and is the chief animation director, and Masahiro Yokotani ( Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! , Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- , Beelzebub , The Devil Is a Part-Timer! ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts.

Sangatsu no Phantasia performs the opening theme song "Kaze no Naka wa Hashirukkya Inai," and Akari Nanawo performs the ending theme song "Pi."

Seven Seas publishes the manga in English and describes the story:

In a student council filled with weirdos, one new member is about to have a hell of a school year! Mizunoe Ume just wanted to avoid repeating a grade when he joined the student council. After all, it seemed like an easy fix to his current academic problems. But then, he met his fellow council members. Each of them is eccentric in their own way—one's an airhead, another's scary, one's secretly a pervert, but all in all, they're just really weird! Yet somehow, they're also oddly cute and endearing. Which means Mizunoe is stuck with them and all the chaos they bring to the table. Get ready for a slice-of-life manga that's irresistibly charming, quirky, and a little bit naughty!

Muchimaro launched the manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in 2022. Kodansha shipped the 13th compiled book volume on August 17. Seven Seas shipped the first volume on September 8, and will ship the second volume on December 8. K MANGA also publishes the series in English digitally.

The manga received an animated ad in July 2024. The manga won in the print category of the ninth Next Manga Awards (Tsugi ni Kuru Manga Taishō) in 2023.

title: Shonen Jump’s Next Surprise Live-Action Movie Casts Netflix’s One Piece Zoro as Its Hero – Watch Trailer
content:
Mackenyu, Netflix’s One Piece Zoro, will lead Shonen Jump ‘s next live-action adaptation, and it’s perfect casting. The Japanese actor has become one of the most important cast members in live-action adaptations of Shonen Jump titles, with his casting as Zoro in Netflix’s One Piece undoubtedly being a career highlight. The second season of the live-action series saw Mackenyu getting into even better shape for Zoro’s role, showcasing the perfect physique. However, with his latest casting in another Shonen Jump live-action adaptation, it seems Mackenyu has been preparing for this role as well, and it couldn’t be more perfect.

On November 4, it was announced that Mashle: Magic and Muscles is getting a live-action adaptation , with the ambitious project scheduled to release on March 19, 2027. However, the initial announcement did not reveal any casting details, focusing instead on the studio behind the adaptation and Warner Bros.’ partnership with Fuji TV to oversee production by the renowned studio CREDEUS. Now, just a day later, new information has been unveiled through a teaser, confirming that Mackenyu will play Mash Burnedead, and he looks perfect for the role.

Mashle: Magic and Muscles Live-Action Movie Casts Netflix’s One Piece Zoro as Its Hero

The announcement also offers a closer look at Mash Burnedead, with the hand-drawn scar on his face prominently highlighted. However, it is the teaser trailer that perfectly embodies what the series represents. One shot shows Mackenyu as Mash Burnedead from behind, holding a dumbbell in his right hand, highlighting the premise as the narrator describes how Mash will embark on a journey to revolutionize the magical world using nothing but his muscles. The teaser also playfully showcases his extraordinary strength, with Mash seen bench-pressing an unimaginable weight at incredible speed. It is a perfect representation of the character, with Mackenyu’s unbothered expression as Mash further capturing his personality from the series.

Mashle ‘s live-action adaptation is undoubtedly an unexpected announcement. However, based on what has been revealed so far, it could become one of next year’s biggest live-action anime movies . With Warner Bros. handling distribution and the renowned studio CREDEUS overseeing production, the movie already has a strong foundation. The studio has a reputation for adapting live-action titles, having also worked on the successful adaptation of Sakamoto Days . Now, with Mackenyu cast as Mash Burnedead, the movie has seemingly captured all the right elements and only needs to execute them well, something its current foundation suggests it can accomplish.

The only disappointing aspect is that, despite its release date being revealed, the movie is currently scheduled for release only in Japan, leaving its international release uncertain. Considering that Sakamoto Days did not receive a proper international release date, there are concerns that the movie might never make it overseas. However, fans won’t be completely deprived of Mashle next year, as the anime’s third season is set to arrive in January 2027 , continuing the epic Divine Visionary arc. For now, it is shaping up to be a great year for Mashle: Magic and Muscles , with a live-action adaptation featuring a renowned cast and a new anime season potentially allowing the series to reclaim its position as one of Shonen Jump’s surprise leading titles, despite the manga having ended years ago.

title: MAGES. Works on New Girls und Panzer Console Game
content:
The official website of the Girls und Panzer das Finale film series reported on October 30 that a "new consumer game" by MAGES will be announced at the " Girls und Panzer Mini Mini Hobby Show" during the "Oarai Ankō Matsuri 2026" event on November 14. ("Consumer game" is a Japanese term for a game for consoles or portable game systems, as opposed to a game for arcades, personal computers, or phones.)

The fifth film of Girls und Panzer das Finale opened in Japan on October 9. The film is screening in Dolby Cinema, Dolby Atmos, 4DX, and MX4D, in addition to normal screenings. This marks the first time the film series is playing in Dolby Cinema.

The fifth film is set after Ōarai Girls High School's win in the fierce semi-finals of the Winter Continuous Track Cup, and they head to the finals, where they will face St. Gloriana Girls' College, led by Darjeeling. Among the members of St. Gloriana Girls' College is Alice, who transferred to St. Gloriana to be able to face Miho again.

The first Girls und Panzer das Finale film opened in Japan in 59 theaters in December 2017. The film features new characters from BC Freedom High School as they engage in a winter battle.

The second film opened in Japan in June 2019. The film depicts the finale of the battle between Ōarai Girls Academy and BC Freedom High School, and also shows the battles for Kuromorimine Girls Academy, Pravda Girls High School, and other schools.

The third film opened in Japanese theaters in March 2021. The film features six more schools competing on three additional battlegrounds.

The fourth film opened in Japan in October 2023. The fourth film continues with Ōarai's battle with Continuation (Jaktkosota) High School, after the loss of important teammates at the onset of the match in the third film. The film also shows the match between two strong schools, Kuromorimine and St. Gloriana, with Kuromorimine headed up by Maho's successor Erika, and St. Gloriana's commander Darjeeling in her last match.

The four Girls und Panzer: Motto Love Love Sakusen Desu! films opened in order on December 26, January 30, March 6, and April 10. The manga that spawned these films follows the unknown daily lives of the Ōarai Girls Team and other students. Maruko Nii launched the manga in 2013 in Kadokawa 's (then Media Factory 's) Monthly Comic Alive magazine.

The fourth Girls und Panzer: Motto Love Love Sakusen Desu! film included a "pilot video" based on Takeshi Nogami and Takaaki Suzuki 's Girls und Panzer: Ribon no Musha manga.

The Girls und Panzer television anime premiered in October 2012 and had 12 episodes. The Girls und Panzer der Film anime film follow up opened in Japan in November 2015.

title: A Few Moments of Cheers' Studio Hurray! Animates Wondering Mate Net Shorts
content:
Hurray! , one of the animation studios for A Few Moments of Cheers film, is planning and animating Wondering Mate , an original short anime that will premiere on Meta Taxi's YouTube channel on December 16. Meta Taxi is streaming an English-subtitled teaser:

Meta Taxi describes the anime's story, set in another world where avatars from discontinued apps live:

Aco, a high school girl avatar who dreams of becoming human, and Bit, an avatar who wants nothing to do with becoming human. A story of two avatars who may be changing, in a world that was never supposed to change.

Yuno Nakahara plays Aco, and Nobuhiko Okamoto plays Bit.

Inu Hirayama, a member of the comedy sketch duo TentenHanten, is making his anime scripting debut with this project. Kodansha 's Shunsuke Sagawa and DNP's Saki Nakao are producing.

Meta Taxi is a YouTube channel that streams talk sessions with guests on various topics — only the sessions are set in a virtual taxi roaming Tokyo at night. Wondering Mate is Meta Taxi's first original short anime, and it will have 12 3-minute episodes.

title: Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal Anime Reveals Main Visual and Voice Cast
content:
CODE GEASS Star Chaser Aspal new anime revealed the main key visual, along with the main voice cast members. The anime was announced in September, with the release date set for 2027.

Kazuya Nomura is directing the project, with Mado Nozaki handling series composition. Rolua is responsible for the character designs, while Yoshi. is designing the Agalmata. SUNRISE is credited with the original work, planning and animation production. The main voice cast includes:

• Ivan Shibata as Aspal

• Hibiku Yamamura as Zoé

You can see the new visual below.

You can watch the teaser trailer below.

Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion is an original anime series by studio SUNRISE. Goro Taniguchi directed it, with Ichiro Okouchi writing the script. CLAMP was in charge of the original character designs. The first season aired from October 2006 to July 2007, while the sequel titled Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion R2 aired from April 2008 to September 2008. They had 25 episodes each. The franchise has a multitude of OVA side stories, manga and light novel adaptations, as well as several movies. A recap movie trilogy released between 2017 and 2018, but it was set in an alternate universe and changed some things from the TV anime. The movies were followed by an original sequel movie titled Code Geass: Lelouch of the Re;surrection in 2019. The latest anime for the franchise was the Code Geass: Rozé of the Recapture movie. It released over 4 parts from May to August 2024, with an episodic version also sreaming on Disney from June 21, 2024.

Ivan Shibata as Aspal
Hibiku Yamamura as Zoé
You can see the new visual below.
You can watch the teaser trailer below.

Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion is an original anime series by studio SUNRISE. Goro Taniguchi directed it, with Ichiro Okouchi writing the script. CLAMP was in charge of the original character designs. The first season aired from October 2006 to July 2007, while the sequel titled Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion R2 aired from April 2008 to September 2008. They had 25 episodes each. The franchise has a multitude of OVA side stories, manga and light novel adaptations, as well as several movies. A recap movie trilogy released between 2017 and 2018, but it was set in an alternate universe and changed some things from the TV anime. The movies were followed by an original sequel movie titled Code Geass: Lelouch of the Re;surrection in 2019. The latest anime for the franchise was the Code Geass: Rozé of the Recapture movie. It released over 4 parts from May to August 2024, with an episodic version also sreaming on Disney from June 21, 2024.

title: 'Fool Night' Unveils Additional Cast, Theme Songs, First Promo
content:
The official website of the Fool Night original net anime unveiled additional cast, a key visual (pictured), the theme songs, and first promotional video on Thursday. The anime adapting Kasumi Yasuda 's sci-fi drama manga will debut worldwide exclusively on Netflix on November 26.

Cast Sumi Matsuno: Shion Wakayama ( Dandadan ) Ken Hikasa: Hiroshi Tsuchida ( Usagi Drop ) Nishi: Nobuhiko Okamoto ( Boku no Hero Academia ) Mei Okumura: Sayaka Senbongi ( Dungeon Meshi ) Ivy: Yumiko Kobayashi ( Soul Eater )

Music group Tempalay ( Sand Land: The Series ending theme) is performing the opening theme "Shake! spit out." Singer Nowlu ( Yuusha Party wo Oidasareta Kiyoubinbou ) is performing the ending theme "Iki." The opening theme is previewed in the first promotional video below.

Atsushi Yukawa ( Suzume no Tojimari episode director) helms the anime at Sunrise and Shaft . Jin Tanaka ( [Oshi no Ko] ) is handling the series composition and Robert Satou is designing the characters. Tatsuya Katou ( Dr. Stone ) is composing the music.

Yasuda began serializing the sci-fi drama in Big Comic Superior magazine in November 2020. Shogakukan published the 13th volume on June 30.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in October 2023 and released the tenth volume on September 15. The 11th volume is planned to go on sale on December 15.

PV 1

title: Fool Night Anime's Trailer Reveals Theme Songs, Additional Cast
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks unveiled a new trailer, visual, theme song artists, and additional cast for the television anime of Kasumi Yasuda 's Fool Night manga on Thursday. The main trailer previews the opening theme song "Shake! spit out" by the band Tempalay :

Nowlu performs the ending theme song "Iki" (Breath).

The newly announced cast includes:

Previously announced cast members include:

• Kōki Uchiyama as Toshiro Kamiya

• Minako Kotobuki as Yomiko Horai

• Junya Enoki as Akira Yatsuka

• Aya Endō as Saeko Kanaeno

• Kiyomitsu Mizuuchi as Jin Hiragishi

Atsuyuki Yukawa ( Suzume unit director) is directing the anime at Sunrise and SHAFT . Jin Tanaka ( Oshi no Ko ) is writing the script. Robert Satō is designing the characters. Tatsuya Katō ( Dr. Stone ) is composing the music.

Other staff members include:

• Assistant Director: Ryō Shimura

• Visual Development: Ryō Kikuchi

• Art Director: Maki Takano (J.C. Staff)

• Color Design: Jin Hibino

• Director of Photography: Mana Ishikawa (animocaramel), Chiaki Tokuda (Tera Effect), Takayuki Aizu (SHAFT)

• CG Directors: Naoki Yamamoto, Junya Hirano

• Editing: Rie Matsubara (Seyama Editing Room)

• Sound Director: Yōta Tsuruoka

Viz Media licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

Kamiya is at the end of his rope. His mother is ill, and his job barely pays for her medication, much less food. With few options left, he considers the life-changing process of transfloration. Ready to give his body up for a payday, Kamiya is about to explore the limits of society's waning humanity.

Yasuda launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Big Comic Superior magazine in November 2020. Shogakukan released the manga's 13th compiled book volume on June 30.

The manga ranked #12 in the male reader list of the 2023 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook.
